name: Klamra Paycal for Aspaclaria
author: klamra22

sections.description:
PayCal is a simple and powerful payment solution for WooCommerce stores.

The plugin allows WordPress store owners to accept payments and manage invoices directly from their WooCommerce store.

Features

  • Accept Bit payments
  • Accept credit card payments
  • Send automatic invoices
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration
  • Simple setup and lightweight plugin

PayCal is designed to be easy to use while providing the tools needed to manage payments and invoices efficiently.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/klamra-paycal-for-aspaclaria
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Payments
  4. Enable PayCal
  5. Configure your PayCal settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

What payment methods are supported?

The plugin supports Bit payments, credit cards and invoice generation.

Is the plugin easy to configure?

Yes. The plugin integrates directly with WooCommerce and requires minimal setup.
